(HEARD BY HONBLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE , HONBLE A.M. KHANWILKAR AND 
HONBLE DR. D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, JJ.)
Date : 27­03­2018 This petition was called on for JUDGMENT 
    today.
For Petitioner(s)
Mr. Kush Chaturvedi, Adv. [AOR]
                   
For Respondent(s)
Mr. Baij Nath Patel, Adv.
Ms. Sweta, Adv.
Ms. Romila, Adv.
for
Mr. Gurmeet Singh Makker, Adv. [AOR]
                    
Hon’ble   Dr.   Justice   D.Y.   Chandrachud   pronounced   the
Order of the Bench comprising Hon’ble the Chief Justice of
India; Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.M. Khanwilkar and His Lordship
directing   that   Justice   Jawad   Rahim   shall   discharge   the
duties of Chairperson of the National Green Tribunal for all
purposes, including participating in the selection process
for   filling   up   vacancies   of   members,   until   a   regular
appointment of  a  new  Chairperson  is made  and  as per the
terms of the Signed Reportable Order.
(Subhash Chander)               (H.S. Parasher)
